ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-mid macro-level ratio; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution appearing as mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark regions occupy the leading edges and lower-central area. Distinct white/light-grey mottling and localized spot clusters are mapped across the right lobe (distal and central regions) and scattered across the upper-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box offset from the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; includes sharp peaks and shallow valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a convex sweep tapering into sharp, elongated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular/oval high-contrast white pixel groups (likely barnacle scars) concentrated heavily on the right lobe and center-left region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible, particularly three distinct parallel lines on the center-right lobe and several shorter disruptions on the lower-left surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the center and right lobes; heavy localized mottling/scarring on the distal end of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, secondary indentation or notch is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip, distinct from standard serrations.
